exceptions.justification: Accepted by the maintainer for Hospital 1.8.3 on 2026-11-12 (as for 1.8.0 to 1.8.2): an unfixed finding. Caddy 2.11.7 and its Smallstep certificate path still compile go-jose/v3, and upstream has no patched v3 release for this advisory (Caddy 2.11.8 and 2.11.9 do not carry one either). go-jose/v4 is already at 4.1.6; this exact finding is accepted until upstream removes or patches v3. The other nine images scan clean.

Accepted by the maintainer for Hospital 1.8.3 on 2026-11-12: an unfixed Debian 13 finding in the Kerberos client libraries of the PostgreSQL image (no fixed version in trixie yet). The database accepts connections only from other containers on the internal network and does not use GSSAPI or Kerberos authentication. Re-scanned each release; remove when Debian ships the fix.
